name: Evodia
title: Co-worker in Philippi
summary: Evodia was a female leader in the church at Philippi who had struggled side by side with Paul in the service of the gospel. She is known from Paul's letter where he urges her and Syntyche to be of one mind in the Lord.

keyEvents.title: Co-worker in the gospel
keyEvents.description: Evodia struggled together with Paul in the service of the gospel and was an important contributor to the growth of the church in Philippi.

keyEvents.title: Urging for unity
keyEvents.description: Paul urges Evodia and Syntyche to have the same mind in the Lord, which suggests a disagreement between these two prominent women in the church.

keyEvents.title: Name written in the book of life
keyEvents.description: Paul confirms that Evodia's name is written in the book of life, along with other co-workers, as a testimony to her faith.
